host_contention: Correctness tests ran concurrently on the host. During the remaining scenario queue, a separate correctness worker bootstrapped a Linux container in the existing Rancher VM capped at 2 CPUs and 4 GiB, with public dependency downloads followed by network-off tests.
timing_boundary: The VM workload was reported after Base completed and while Docs was running; exact per-trial overlap was not sampled. Earlier host correctness tests also overlapped evaluation work.
isolation: No competing model benchmark workload or live Feishu API workload was reported. Candidate/evaluator/model/tool settings remain pinned.
interpretation: Wall-clock and API latency may reflect host CPU, memory or network contention and must not be attributed solely to CLI behavior. Provider-token and success-accounting rules are unchanged; observed timeouts would remain visible in outcomes/usage.
hardware_measurement_limit: No controlled idle-host or hardware-normalized latency experiment is claimed.
